640:t_1:249.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's right, $$ノノ$$. We are warriors who protect the Earth.」

640:t_1:250.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The day will surely come when we meet $$ラルク$$ again. Until then, let's do our best.」

640:t_1:253.en:
$$ノノ$$
(...'I'm not your Big Sis'... In the end, I'm leaving without ever being able to ask what Big Sis meant by those words back then...)

640:t_1:254.en:
$$ノノ$$
(But $$ノノ$$ believes... that we will surely meet Big Sis again in the galactic sea...)

640:t_2:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Its name is $$エル・ミレニウム$$. An emissary of judgment.」

640:t_3:3.en: ～ Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier '$$スヴェル$$' ～

640:t_3:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$スヴェル$$ completion confirmed. Also, the remaining enemy units appear to have touched the barrier and been warped into the gap between dimensions.」

640:t_3:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「...We've gone and done it now...」

640:t_3:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... From here on, we have no choice but to keep moving forward.」

640:t_3:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You called it the Earth Defense Dimensional Barrier, but...」

640:t_3:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Just as the name says, it is a defensive field that completely covers the Earth.」

640:t_3:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The Earth Defense Plan is built on two pillars: the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 for offense and $$スヴェル$$ for defense.」

640:t_3:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$スヴェル$$... That's the name of the strongest shield in Norse mythology, isn't it?」

640:t_3:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, my proposal was the one chosen for the name.」

640:t_3:13.en:
$n
(The same concept as the names of the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons, huh...)

640:t_3:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「That doesn't seem to be a simple wall of energy, though...」

640:t_3:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. $$スヴェル$$ warps causality on its surface and has the power to halt laws coming from the outside.」

640:t_3:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Simply put, the inside of that is a space that receives no interference from the outside at all.」

640:t_3:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's what you evacuated the residents of the colonies, $$翠の地球$$ and Mars to $$蒼の地球$$ for?」

640:t_3:18.en:
$$シン$$
「That's amazing! It's truly an absolute shield!」

640:t_3:19.en:
$$赤木$$
「As expected of the crystallization of humanity's wisdom for defense! With this, the Earth is safe!」

640:t_3:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's not quite that simple...」

640:t_3:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Unlike the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, which was researched over a considerable period, that was rushed into development on short notice.」

640:t_3:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「Does it have some kind of flaw?」

640:t_3:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Its concept is the same as the $$時の牢獄$$ from the $$時獄戦役$$.」

640:t_3:25.en:
$$葵$$
「A world where time flows differently... In other words, a world with laws completely separate from its surroundings.」

640:t_3:26.en:
$$トライア$$
「Understanding it as a phenomenon is one thing, but actually doing it is a whole different matter.」

640:t_3:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's why $$スヴェル$$ is pretty much something forcibly created by using $$次元力$$.」

640:t_3:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So that's why the $$霊子吸収システム$$ and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ were used.」

640:t_3:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then that barrier is being completed by putting someone's life in danger!?」

640:t_3:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Participation is left to free will, but many people volunteered to cooperate in order to protect the Earth.」

640:t_3:31.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is $$リリーナ$$... one of them too?」

640:t_3:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Is that also why I couldn't find out where $$ナナリー$$ was this past month...!)

640:t_3:34.en:
$$刹那$$
($$沙慈$$, $$ルイス$$... You two are in there as well...)

640:t_3:35.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Strong spirit quanta... so they're people with the power of life...」

640:t_3:36.en:
$$トライア$$
「But it's ultimately a stopgap of hastily acquired technology and knowledge. The energy extraction rate is poor, and its efficiency at event control is nothing to brag about either.」

640:t_3:37.en:
$$トライア$$
「Once it's activated, it's a one-shot, disposable system, and its lifespan is a month at best.」

640:t_3:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That means we have to defeat $$バアル$$ and settle things with the $$御使い$$s who are targeting the Earth within that month...」

640:t_3:40.en:
$$トライア$$
「Exactly. In other words, a month from now is the Earth's last day.」

640:t_3:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, that's understandable... Even in the fighting until just now, the power of the $$御使い$$s was shown to us more than enough.」

640:t_3:46.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$エル・ミレニウム$$ and the $$アンゲロイ・アルカ$$...」

640:t_3:47.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we can't even fight them properly, overthrowing the $$御使い$$s is nothing but a dream...」

640:t_3:48.en:
$n
「But... if there's no turning back, all we can do is move forward...」

640:t_3:49.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The people staying behind will protect the Earth... So let's do the fighting.」

640:t_3:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even the time to hesitate is a waste now.」

640:t_3:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... Let's go, to the galaxy.」

640:t_3:52.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's hurry up and set sail! Out there, a bunch of bad gods, $$バアル$$ and the $$御使い$$s are waiting for us!」

640:t_3:53.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Right...! All ships, prepare for an ultra-long-range warp!」

640:t_3:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$, begin communicating with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

640:t_3:56.en:
$$スズネ$$
(At last... the final battle for the future of humanity is about to begin...)

640:t_3:57.en:
$n
(I'll overcome it... the future of despair, the fundamental calamity... and fate as well...)

640:t_3:62.en:
???
(The door is opened, and the future is closed...)

640:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our wish... I have been preparing for it all the way to today.」

640:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By crushing the $$御使い$$s' lackeys in today's battle, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z were produced. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

640:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But that road is steep and endless. Unfortunately, we haven't even reached its entrance yet.」

640:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Given that situation, I will save my congratulations to the ace pilots for another occasion.」

640:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But there is one thing you must not forget. Another day of giving it our all: business, business...」

640:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe these words will save the world...」

640:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our wish... I have been preparing for it all the way to today.」

640:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But that road is steep and endless. Unfortunately, we haven't even reached its entrance yet.」
